After obtaining information from a [[Spy/Legends|spy]] named [[Bellis]], the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Republic]] [[Republic Special Forces Division|Special Forces]] unit known as [[Havoc Squad]] '''sent''' [[Captain/Legends|Captain]] [[Zora]] and a newly-recruited [[Meteor (Havoc Squad)|Sergeant]] to recover a captured [[ZR-57 orbital strike bomb]]. Although the two [[Soldier/Legends|soldiers]] were unable to locate the [[Bomb/Legends|bomb]] due to it being moved by the separatists, the [[Sergeant/Legends|Sergeant]] was able to eliminate three separatist leaders named [[Bol (Separatist)|Bol]], [[Saphrro]], and [[Vyru]].<ref name="MP" />
